newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on Major election win.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on Major election win.

text.p: Bookmakers William Hill said on Tuesday it had cut the odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the British election to 11-4 from 3-1.
Labour is quoted as 1-4 favourites and a hung parliament, where no party has an overall majority, is available at 3-1.
May remains the 8-11 favourite for the month in which the election will be held with March at 6-4, April at 7-2 and February at 100-1. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
